- Can you confirm the single canonical legal entity we should use for Redwood contracts (legal name, jurisdiction, and tax id/VAT)?
- We saw two related entries in our supplier registry ("Ora Supply US LLC" and "Ora Supply International Ltd."). Please confirm which entity will receive POs vs which will receive invoices (if different).
- Attachments: I’ve included a short onboarding form and a remit CSV — please complete and return. If you have a standardized vendor packet (W-9 equivalent, certificate of incorporation, bank remit instructions), attach that too.

Attachments (stubbed): redwood_onboarding_form_v2.pdf, remit_sheet.csv

Important note on PO fallback: if the primary legal entity cannot accept POs in our ERP, we need a signed addendum and matching tax paperwork for the alternate billing entity. I’ll attach our draft PO fallback policy after we confirm the entity.

Target timeline: can we get the completed forms and any legal docs by EOD May 12? If not, share a short timeline and any blockers.

Thanks —

Hi Naomi —

Thanks for the note. We can do the EOD May 12 target. Quick answers up front:

- Canonical legal entity for contracts: Ora Supply US LLC (EIN: 12-3456789).
- Billing: typically Ora Supply International Ltd. invoices are routed to international clients; however for US-based customers (and marketplaces) Ora Supply US LLC is the bill-to.

I’ve attached a zipped packet with our certificate of formation, US tax letter, and a copy of our standard bank remit instructions. There’s also a short note about why we appear twice in some registries — we operate two legal entities for tax/regulatory reasons but use a single procurement point internally.

Attachments (stubbed): ORA_legal_pack.zip

Question on PO fallback: if a PO is issued to the International Ltd. entity (because of accounting setup on your side), will Redwood accept invoices from that entity or do you require a cross-entity MSA/PO addendum? We can sign paperwork quickly if that’s preferable.
